text:
Source-assisted selected reading of F-kr2n (Paris, BnF, NAL 2317, ff. 4-5). The lines below were reread on the image by a research reader with Liverani's printed text (snippets) and Paris, BnF, Latin 3806 at hand: fol. 4v col. b lines 5-23 and fol. 5v col. a on enlarged crops, fol. 5r col. b at reduced size. All other lines of fols. 4r, 4v and 5r rest on the image-only first reading; fol. 5v col. b and the upper part of fol. 5r col. a were not read. (..) = expanded abbreviation; [..] = lost or not read; ? = uncertain; & = et-ligature.
